title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues the commentary (items e and f) on the large commutative diagram (62). That diagram relates the groups attached to a pair (ρ,σ) in Grothendieck's 'variations sur l'équation des lacets'. The groups are Γ_{ρ,σ}, S₀Γ_{ρ,σ}, M_{ρ,σ}, S₀M_{ρ,σ}, Z_{ρ,σ}, G_{ρ,σ}, N*_ρ, N*_σ and the terminal group γ_{ρ,σ}. It also uses the cyclotomic-type character χ_γ: γ_{ρ,σ} → Ẑ* and the sign characters ε_{γ,ρ}, ε_{γ,σ}: γ_{ρ,σ} → {±1}.

Item e) is pure notation.
(63) names the canonical maps δ_Γ, δ_{S₀Γ}, δ_M, δ_{S₀M} of these groups to γ_{ρ,σ}.
(64) defines the characters χ_? = χ_γ ∘ δ_? to Ẑ*.
By composition one also gets sign characters ε_{?,ρ}, ε_{?,σ}: ? → {±1}. Here ? ranges over Z, G, N*_ρ, N*_σ, Γ, S₀Γ, M, S₀M, with ε_{N_ρ,ρ} = ε_ρ and ε_{N_σ,σ} = ε_σ.
For every such group a systematic family of subgroups is fixed:
- ?^+ = Ker χ_?
- ?' = Ker ε_{?,ρ}
- ?'' = Ker ε_{?,σ}
- ?^0 = ?' ∩ ?''
- ?^{+'} = ?^+ ∩ ?'
- ?^{+''} = ?^+ ∩ ?''
- ?^{+0} = ?^+ ∩ ?^0
- S? = Ker δ_?
These give a cube (65) of inclusions. The bottom face is ?^0 ⊂ ?', ?'' ⊂ ?; the top face is ?^{0+} ⊂ ?^{'+}, ?^{''+} ⊂ ?^+. The vertical arrows are the inclusions of the + versions. Grothendieck jokingly calls it a 'cube intérieur'. A marginal note flags a clash with the earlier notation N'_ρ, N'_σ.

Item f) recalls commutativities for the group 𝔊 (gothic G). The triangle (66) involves ε_{𝔊,ρ}, ε_{𝔊,σ}: 𝔊 → {±1} ⊂ Ẑ* and χ_𝔊: 𝔊 → Ẑ*. It says these coincide via {±1} ↪ Ẑ*, defining a single ε_𝔊: 𝔊 → {±1}.

The purpose is bookkeeping. It sets up a uniform kernel/sign/character nomenclature for the many arithmetic-symmetry groups that act on solutions of the 'loop equation'. This is the setting of the Grothendieck–Teichmüller programme (action of Ĝ_Q and its variants via the cyclotomic character, plus orientation signs attached to ρ and σ).
errors: No mathematical errors; the content is notation. There is a minor notational inconsistency between ?^{+,0} in the definitions and ?^{0+} in the cube (65).
Grothendieck himself notes, in the margin, the clash of ?' and ?'' with the earlier N'_ρ, N'_σ.

ideas.what: Uniform notation: kernels of the cyclotomic-type character and of two sign characters, their intersections, and the resulting cube of subgroups for each group mapping to γ_{ρ,σ}
ideas.modern_name: Kernels of characters / fibre-product lattice of finite-index subgroups (e.g. analogues of GT vs GT^+ restrictions)
ideas.where_published: Not in published texts as such; the context relates to the Esquisse / Longue Marche themes

ideas.what: Compatibility of the two sign characters with the Ẑ*-valued character on 𝔊 (66)
ideas.modern_name: Restriction of the cyclotomic character to an order-2 piece / complex-conjugation-type sign

deep.surprise_reason: Pure notational housekeeping (naming maps, kernels and a cube of intersections). There is no new result or connection on this page.
transcription_corrections: The cube (65) should read: top face ?^{0+}, ?^{'+}, ?^{''+}, ?^+; bottom face ?^0, ?', ?'', ?. The struck-out text before ?^{0+} and the 'au[?]' after ?^+ are cancellations or the word 'au' leading into 'cube intérieur'.
In (66) the source group is gothic 𝔊; the diagram has the three arrows ε_{𝔊,ρ} to {±1}, χ_𝔊 to Ẑ*, and ε_{𝔊,σ} to {±1}, with both {±1} mapping to Ẑ*.
The page number written on the sheet is 561 (bottom left); the previous page carries 560 in the transcription.
